H5163.name: Naham
H5163.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5163.brief: Brother of Hodiah who married Ishbar.
H5163.short: Naham, the brother of Hodiah whose son founded Keilah the Garmite city.

H5167.name: Nahamani
H5167.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5167.brief: One who returned from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.
H5167.short: Nahamani was among those who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity with Zerubbabel.

H5171.name: Naharai
H5171.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H5171.brief: One of David's mighty men, Joab's armor-bearer.
H5171.short: Naharai the Beerothite, Joab's armor-bearer, was one of David's mighty men.

H5176G.name: Nahash
H5176G.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H5176G.brief: Ammonite king who besieged Jabesh Gilead.
H5176G.short: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, besieged Jabesh Gilead and threatened to gouge out the right eyes of its inhabitants.

H5176H.name: Nahash
H5176H.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H5176H.brief: Ammonite king, father of Hanun, showed kindness to David.
H5176H.short: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites and father of Hanun, had shown kindness to David, prompting David to send envoys to console Hanun after Nahash's death.

H5176I.name: Nahash
H5176I.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H5176I.brief: Mother of Abigail and Zeruiah, David's sisters.
H5176I.short: Nahash, the mother of David and his sisters Abigail and Zeruiah, is mentioned in the context of Amasa's lineage.

H5176J.name: Nahash
H5176J.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H5176J.brief: King of the Ammonites, provided supplies to David.
H5176J.short: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, provided supplies to David and his men during their time in Mahanaim.

H5184H.name: Nahath
H5184H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5184H.brief: A Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah.
H5184H.short: Nahath was one of the Levites appointed by King Hezekiah to oversee the distribution of offerings and tithes.

H5184G.name: Nahath
H5184G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5184G.brief: A descendant of Esau, a chief of Edom.
H5184G.short: Nahath, a descendant of Esau, was one of the chiefs of Edom.

H5147.name: Nahbi
H5147.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5147.brief: The spy from the tribe of Naphtali.
H5147.short: Nahbi, the son of Vophsi, was the representative from the tribe of Naphtali among the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.

H5152G.name: Nahor
H5152G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5152G.brief: Son of Serug; father of Terah, Abraham's father.
H5152G.short: Nahor, the son of Serug and father of Terah, was Abraham's grandfather.

H5152H.name: Nahor
H5152H.desc: Abraham's brother living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5152H.brief: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.
H5152H.short: Nahor, the son of Terah and brother of Abraham, was the father of Bethuel and the grandfather of Rebekah.

H5177.name: Nahshon
H5177.brief: Son of Amminadab, leader of Judah, ancestor of David.
H5177.short: Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, was a leader of the tribe of Judah during the Exodus and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

H5151.name: Nahum
H5151.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5151.brief: Old Testament prophet, author of the Book of Nahum.
H5151.short: Nahum, identified as the Elkoshite, was a prophet of God who delivered a message of judgment against the Assyrian city of Nineveh.

H5109.name: Nebai
H5109.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5109.brief: A leader who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H5109.short: Nebai was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah to follow God's law.

H5161.name: Nehelamites
H5161.brief: Hometown of the false prophet Shemaiah
H5161.short: Nehelam was the hometown of Shemaiah, a false prophet who opposed Jeremiah.

H5166G.name: Nehemiah
H5166G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5166G.brief: A leader who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem.
H5166G.short: Nehemiah was among the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylonian exile to Jerusalem.

H5166H.name: Nehemiah
H5166H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5166H.brief: Governor of Judah, rebuilt Jerusalem's walls.
H5166H.short: Nehemiah, the son of Hacaliah, served as the governor of Judah and led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls in the mid-5th century BC.

H5166I.name: Nehemiah
H5166I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5166I.brief: Son of Azbuk, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.
H5166I.short: Nehemiah, the son of Azbuk, was a leader who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David during the rebuilding process led by Nehemiah the governor.

H5179.name: Nehushta
H5179.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5179.brief: Mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah.
H5179.short: Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem, was the mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah.

H5129G.name: Noadiah
H5129G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5129G.short: Noadiah was a Levite entrusted with the oversight of the treasuries during the time of Ezra.

H5129H.name: Noadiah
H5129H.desc: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
H5129H.short: Noadiah was a false prophetess who opposed Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

H5146.name: Noah
H5146.desc: Flood survivor living at the time before the Flood
H5146.brief: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood
H5146.short: Noah was a righteous man who built the ark and survived the great flood with his family.

H5126.name: Nun
H5126.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5126.short: Nun was the father of Joshua, Moses' assistant and successor as leader of Israel.

H5158M.name: Brook of Egypt
H5158M.brief: Southwestern boundary of the Promised Land
H5158M.short: The Brook of Egypt (Shihor) marked the southwestern boundary of the Promised Land.

H5158K.name: Brook of the Arabah
H5158K.brief: Eastern boundary of Jeroboam II's kingdom
H5158K.short: The Brook of the Arabah was the eastern boundary of King Jeroboam II's kingdom.

H5158G.name: Brook of the Willows
H5158G.short: The Brook of the Willows was a boundary of Moab's territory, possibly near the Wadi Zered.

H5121.name: Naioth
H5121.brief: A place near Ramah where David fled from Saul
H5121.short: Naioth was a place near Ramah where David fled to escape King Saul, and where Samuel and a group of prophets lived.

H5196.name: Netaim
H5196.brief: A place associated with potters in Judah
H5196.short: Netaim was a place in Judah where potters lived and worked.

H5199.name: Netophah
H5199.brief: A town in Judah, home to several notable individuals
H5199.short: Netophah was a town in Judah, known as the hometown of several notable individuals in the Bible.

H5113.name: Nod
H5113.brief: The land where Cain settled after killing Abel
H5113.short: Nod was the land east of Eden where Cain settled after he was banished for killing his brother Abel.

H5139.name: Nazirites
H5139.brief: Person who took a special vow of dedication
H5139.short: A Nazirite was an individual who took a special vow of dedication to God, abstaining from wine, cutting hair, and avoiding corpses.

H5180.name: Nehushtan
H5180.brief: The bronze serpent made by Moses in the wilderness
H5180.short: Nehushtan, mentioned in <ref="2Ki.18.4">2Ki.18.4</ref>, was the name given to the bronze serpent that Moses made in the wilderness (<ref="Numbers 21:8-9">Numbers 21:8-9</ref>), which had become an object of idolatrous worship by the time of King Hezekiah.
